title: polyscias cenabrei
intro: Polyscias cenabrei, commonly known as Cenabrei Tree or Polyscias, is a plant species in the family Araliaceae. This plant is traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Polyscias cenabrei include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which help to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and bring down fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
